value.rationale: A direct natural local-versus-global dependence problem under an important precisely specified Catalan null model: number of minimal two-leaf fringe patterns versus total leaf depths (Sackin balance cost). The exact covariance distinguishes competing shapes even when their one-dimensional means are already known; the all-n strict negative sign and sharp n^{3/2} magnitude are structural information suitable for joint shape diagnostics and asymptotic scaling. This is not a renamed marginal identity or a fixed-size table.
